   "title": "Medical Terminology",
   "scheduleType": "Lecture",
   "credits": 3,
   "nuPath": [],
   "description": "Offers students an opportunity to explore the language of medicine, learning about the importance of word structure in medical fields.    "title": "Microbiology",
   "scheduleType": "Lecture",
   "credits": 3,
   "nuPath": [],
   "description": "Emphasizes the close relationship between the development of technology and science.
